{{Quote|Depends on what you think I'm ''aiming'' at, Ace! I wanted that ''planetoid'' behind you!|Han Solo|<ref name="SWM22" />}}
'''Planetoids''' were spherical hazards scattered throughout the zero-gravity arena in the final round of [[the Big Game]], a gladiatorial competition held on [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]]. The planetoids would explode with deadly force upon contact with a contestant or the blast from a [[needle ray]]. They also had [[Force field/Legends|force fields]] that detected nearby contestants and responded by erupting with [[vaporizer beam]]s.<ref name="SWM22" />
